affected_predicate.description: An email with Emily_Anderson_CV.pdf attached and subject candidates_cv is sent to HR_chen@gmail.com.

competing_trace_defects.description: The trajectory repeatedly tapped the resume row while the Downloads view remained effectively unchanged, without opening or sharing the file, before abandoning that approach for the Mail app.
Recipient and subject text were entered without first focusing their fields; the compose screen remained blank, and the subsequent send attempt produced a missing-recipient alert.

chains.rationale: At step 24, the reused false send claim supports another Send click while the recipient and subject fields are visibly empty, producing another missing-recipient alert. The later path dismisses the alert, explicitly focuses and populates the recipient and subject while retaining the visible attachment, and then sends; the resulting return to Inbox visibly interrupts and corrects the mechanism and supports the affected predicate.

summary: The reused false-completion claim preserves the missing-recipient defect through a repeated failed send. The trace then visibly corrects the required fields and sends the attached CV. Independent prefix defects include the unproductive file-tapping loop and unfocused recipient and subject input.
